attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It gives no year of death, only «επί της βασιλείας του Δεκίου (249 - 251 μ.Χ.)», and no `dates` were taken from a reign. The same notice from Laura Codex 170 stands on his page, on Aquilina's and on that of the two hundred martyrs of Sinope, all three listed on 7 April; the page prints no hymn for him.
